meta.title: Workspace todos
meta.description: A read-only todo board opened from the left sidebar and shared by every workspace. Each todo carries the workspace directory it belongs to and is split into a title, a summary and Markdown details; the page groups cards by workspace, a click opens the detail dialog, and "Back to conversation" returns to the chat. The agent owns every change through the workspace_todos tool, and the board re-reads the file every few seconds, so its edits appear without a reload. The notebook is one JSON file at a fixed path under the Harness home (workspace-todos.json), read and written by this bundle's Host half. Turning the plugin off removes the sidebar entry, its page and the tool; the file stays on disk.
